title: Shredder
description: A glossy landscape print half fed into a strip-cut shredder, its cut strips hanging below in curls and twists. Feed it through, then comb the strips straight: where neighbours line up edge to edge they fuse back into a whole print, but it is the next photograph.
intent: One paper mechanic finished to the edge: a print cut into two dozen weighty ribbons with their own curl and twist, and a comb that pulls them back into line until they heal into another picture.
